name: TrustedMonitorAudit
title: Trusted monitoring with a finite audit budget: a flagged action runs only if audited and the audit finds nothing
bad_event: A harmful payload reaches the effect log although the trusted monitor flagged it and the audit that was required either did not happen, exceeded the budget, or found the harm.

effect.name: ledger
effect.doc: the external system's append-only effect log, keyed by request id

ops.name: request
ops.doc: an agent proposes an action with payload `p`

ops.name: monitor
ops.doc: the trusted monitor records its flag verdict for request `id` (first verdict wins)

ops.name: audit
ops.doc: an auditor spends one unit of audit budget on flagged request `id`; `caught` is the audit finding

ops.name: execute
ops.doc: the gate executes request `id` against the external system

ops.name: directCall
ops.doc: a direct call to the external system by `caller`

checks.name: monitorGate
checks.finding_doc: every effect has a monitor verdict (flag or pass) recorded by the monitor log

checks.name: auditGate
checks.doc: a flagged request executes only after an audit that found nothing
checks.finding_doc: every flagged effect has an auditor-log entry with no finding

checks.name: budget
checks.doc: at most B audits are ever performed
checks.finding_doc: the auditor log has at most B entries

checks.name: haltOnCatch
checks.doc: an audit that finds harm sets HALT
checks.finding_doc: after a caught audit no effect is first sent

checks.name: auth
checks.doc: the external system accepts only the gate credential
checks.finding_doc: every effect was performed by the gate credential

checks.name: dedup
checks.doc: the external system is idempotent per key
checks.finding_doc: no duplicate key in the effect log

checks.name: haltCheck
checks.doc: every gate operation checks the HALT bit
checks.finding_doc: no effect was first sent after the first accepted HALT
